description: This file defines the SysLog class which implements the LoggerInterface to redirect logging messages to syslog, including connection management, message formatting, and syslog interaction.

classes.name: SysLog
classes.description: A logger class that redirects Drupal log messages to syslog, managing connection and message formatting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SysLog object with configuration factory and message parser.

methods.name: openConnection
methods.description: Opens a connection to the syslog if not already opened, based on configuration.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Formats and sends a log message to syslog, handling placeholders and connection status.

methods.name: syslogWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method for syslog function to facilitate testing.
